'PANGALAGAAN ANG SARILI MULA SA PALASYO AT KAY SANDRO'

LOOK: Senator Imee Marcos urged Ilocanos to “be careful” and protect themselves and their communities from “the Palace and Sandro,” saying Ilocos “knows the whole truth.”

She told supporters not to worry about her, adding, “Kaya ito ni Manang.”

Alongside her message, the senator called for an emergency meeting of the League of Municipalities of the Philippines (LMP) – Ilocos Norte Chapter.

All mayors were ordered to attend as the agenda involves “highly urgent matters” requiring unified and immediate action.

The call came a day after Marcos publicly alleged during a rally that her brother, President Bongbong Marcos, is using drugs. The claim prompted Rep. Sandro Marcos to question her behavior as a sister to the President. | via Ian Peter Guanzon #CDNDigital
